items.name: Gulmaure
items.observations: Representative botanical watercolor of Galium verum showing ascending slender branching stems with whorls of fine linear needle-like green leaves (usually eight per node), and dense branching yellow summer-flower panicles. Rootstock and fine rootlets shown. Sources support the overall growth form, yellow flower clusters and narrow leaves arranged in whorls.
items.limitations: Representative illustration only, not a species diagnosis: individual flowers are enlarged and stylized, and some appear to have five lobes instead of the usual four. The flower lobes cannot be reliably counted here, and plant dimensions are not to scale. Check scientific reference photographs to confirm corolla shape and minute leaf characters; the picture is for recognition from the overall habit.
